lines.text: ._custom_main {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; font-family:Pretendard, 'Roboto'; z-index:0;}
._custom_main ._cate_nav ._nav_wrap {position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:83px; background:#fff; z-index:100;}
._custom_main ._cate_nav ._nav a {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%; font-size:20px; color:#ccc; letter-spacing:-0.4px;}
._custom_main ._cate_nav ._brand_view span {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._custom_main ._brand_sec ._brand_cate_title {width:100%; margin-top:141px; text-align:center; font-size:60px; font-weight:bold; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:-1.2px;}
._custom_main ._brand_sec ._marquee {width:100%; height:50px; margin-top:48px; font-size:0; background:#000; z-index:50; user-select:none; pointer-events:none;}
._custom_main ._brand_sec ._marquee ._marquee_wrap > div span {padding:0 19px; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; letter-spacing:-0.32px; text-transform:uppercase;}

._custom_main ._brand_sec ._brand_slider {flex:0 0 1752px; position:relative; width:1752px; margin:20px auto 0 auto; padding-bottom:114px; overflow:hidden; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.4s ease-in;}

._custom_main ._brand_sec ._brand_slider ._item_grid ._item ._new {position:absolute; left:17px; top:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:67px; height:32px; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; background:#F5007F; border-radius:10px;}
._custom_main ._brand_sec ._brand_slider ._slider_current {position:absolute; bottom:45px; left:0; width:100%; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#000; text-align:center; z-index:5;}
._custom_main ._brand_layer {display:none; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:20;}

._custom_main ._brand_layer ._layer_body ._brand_list ._list ._item_box ._item ._new {position:relative; left:0; top:-1px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:37px; height:19px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; background:#000; border-radius:3px; vertical-align:middle;}
